release_notes: MBT POS v3.0.73 UI Stability Update: prevents ghost clicks and millisecond popup flashes, removes the production 60 Hz window scanner, suppresses rapid faulty-touch input and click-through after dialogs, deduplicates license prompts and toast notifications, and never changes tabs during an active sale. Adjust Stock now prevents duplicate submissions, validates without closing the form, clears stale product quantities during search, verifies current stock before writing, and enforces the same Super-Admin, PIN, audit, and accounting policy on desktop and web. Global Search now closes before navigating, and Copilot actions wait for the user instead of opening approval-dialog chains.
